pieces.Text: A zebub records all that it sees and may pass its visions on to another creature.  By remaining in contact with a willing creature, it can replay up to 24 hours of witnessed events, or shorter incidents if it so chooses.  It takes a zebub 1 round to replay 1 hour of recorded images, which the target receives in a flash of information, without sound or other sensory information.  After relaying its findings, the zebub cannot replay its visions of those events again.  A zebub cannot replay its visions for an unwilling creature or as an attack, no matter how horrific the events it might have witnessed.
